meta.name: check-duplicates
meta.description: Check for duplicate or similar cases. Use before deep analysis to avoid investigating the same incident twice. Takes a CASE_ID and returns list of similar cases.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查重复案例，避免重复调查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理安全事件，需要避免重复分析同一案例
copy.tagline_en: Check for duplicate cases to avoid redundant investigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently handle security incidents and need to avoid analyzing the same case twice

howto.what: 在分析前，先检查当前案例是否与已有案例重复或相似，并返回相似案例列表。
howto.when: 当你给出一个案例ID并请求检查重复或相似案例时触发。

say.text: 检查一下案例CASE-123有没有重复的案例。

howto.what_en: Before deep analysis, checks if the current case has duplicates or similar existing cases and returns a list of similar case IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a case ID and ask to check for duplicates or similar cases.
